label: The nine suffice for the field, from the Dei Filius restatement (inference)
rule: Composition of two one-way implications at each being
meaning: A being with the nine has every Dei Filius attribute by the restated sufficiency, and so the primitive field by the field interpretation. This gives STMT-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-SUFFICE its first derivation: its warrant gap becomes the field interpretation plus the seven bridges of nineGiveDeiFilius (with three existing premises). Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
